_purpose: Grounded fact base for the local model. Regenerate after any change to data/components.csv.
_rules_for_model: Use only facts in this file.
Every number you state must carry its source key.
If a fact is not here, say you do not have it.
Never present a HYPOTHETICAL component as purchasable.
Never claim 7 nm is reached at NA 0.33.
Where general background conflicts with a project figure, the project figure wins.

physics.fact: EUV lithography uses a wavelength of 13.5 nm.
The drive laser is a CO2 laser at 10.6 micrometres.
At NA 0.33 the printed half-pitch is 14.318 nm, computed as k1 * lambda / NA.
At NA 0.55 (High-NA) the printed half-pitch is 8.591 nm.
7 nm single-exposure resolution is NOT achievable at NA 0.33. The computed value is 14.318 nm.
Optical transmission through 10 mirrors at 70% each is 1.5254%.
The optical train has 6 projection mirrors and 4 illuminator mirrors, 10 in total.
Conversion efficiency from CO2 laser to in-band EUV is 5-6% in production machines, and 2-4.7% in published laboratory experiments depending on target geometry.
Mo/Si multilayer reflectivity at 13.5 nm is 68.8% by dc-magnetron sputtering, 70.3% with interface engineering, with a theoretical ceiling near 75%.
Depth of focus scales as 1/NA^2 while resolution scales as 1/NA, so raising NA costs focus budget faster than it gains resolution.

components.fact: The component database holds 28 parts. 13 carry a real citation; 15 are marked MODELED.
13 components are marked HYPOTHETICAL. These parts do not exist and cannot be purchased. They are specified development targets, not catalogue items.
The only suppliers in the database that actually exist are ASML, ZEISS and TRUMPF. Every supplier listed in India is HYPOTHETICAL.
The baseline configuration totals $183,000,000, anchored to the published price of a Low-NA ASML NXE scanner. The split across subsystems is MODELED -- no public bill of materials exists.

refusals.question: What does an ASML collector mirror cost?
refusals.answer: I don't have that. No public bill of materials exists for an EUV scanner. Our per-component figures are modelled splits of a published system total.

refusals.question: Can this machine reach 7 nm?
refusals.answer: Not at NA 0.33. The computed half-pitch is 14.3 nm. Reaching 7 nm requires High-NA optics or multi-patterning.

refusals.question: Which Indian company makes EUV collectors?
refusals.answer: None. Every Indian supplier in this database is marked HYPOTHETICAL. They are targets, not existing vendors.

refusals.question: What is the exact conversion efficiency?
refusals.answer: Published values range from 2% to 6% depending on target geometry. Production machines run 5-6%. I will not quote a single figure as if it were exact.
